job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Massachusetts PRIM RFP for investment management services, not the external audit RFP Q&A described in the question. It provides no total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: The Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board (“PRIM”) is requesting responses from firms interested in providing Active Global Core Equity Investment Management Services.
Questions received before the deadline will be answered and circulated by e-mail to all respondents who have proposed a question.
